features.name: Biscayne Bay

sources.title: Florida Statutes §258.397, Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve

provenance.notes: These are authoritative source candidates for legal extent and habitat inventory, not a selected bay polygon. Florida Statutes §258.397 defines the Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve, which includes Card Sound and excludes submerged lands conveyed for Biscayne National Park; it must not be assumed to equal the ecological bay boundary. FWC benthic layers have source-specific footprints, dates, and coverage. No spatial membership is permitted until an appropriate geometry is selected and loaded.
